title: stabilize snapshot replay and per-prompt failure classifier
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Fixes nondeterministic behavior in snapshot replay and adds a lightweight failure classifier that maps regression signals to suggested remediation steps for CI engineers.
description: Motivation: Several intermittent CI failures were traced to non-reproducible snapshot replay runs caused by clock skew in temporal bucketing and inconsistent seeding for prompt replay. This PR stabilizes the snapshot replay path and introduces a per-prompt failure classifier that tags common regression patterns (tokenization drift, context truncation, seed-induced variance) and emits a compact remediation hint in CI output. Changes include: deterministic seeding for replay runs, normalized timestamp bucketing (UTC-aligned, explicit windowing), a replay dry-run mode to detect drift before full CI, a small Bayesian failure classifier with human-readable labels and remediation suggestions, and a CI hook that attaches a replay artifact + classifier summary to failing runs. Checklist: - [x] deterministic seeding implemented and covered by unit tests - [x] timestamp bucketing refactor with backward compatibility shim - [x] classifier model + mapping table added and documented - [x] CI hook emits structured JSON artifact and human summary - [x] added runbook stub at docs/runbooks/replay_runbook.md - [x] integration smoke tests passing - [ ] add long-running flaky-test benchmarks (follow-up ENG-1482). See Linear tasks ENG-1420 and ENG-1482 for context. Links: linear/ENG-1420, SUP-384 for customer incident notes. Impact: should reduce transient CI noise for prompt-set regression checks and make triage faster by surfacing likely root causes in CI output.

risk_assessment: low-medium: changes are localized to the replay path and CI hook. Backwards compatibility shim preserves prior behavior for older snapshots. Classifier is opt-in via config and is non-blocking for production runtime.
how_to_validate: Run tools/ci/attach_artifact.py against a failing replay job to confirm artifact attachment
Execute scripts/replay_dry_run.sh with an exported snapshot id and verify deterministic outputs across repeated runs
Run tests/test_failure_classifier.py locally and confirm label mappings for seeded examples
Trigger CI pipeline ci/pipelines/replay-smoke.yml in staging and confirm classifier-summary artifact is uploaded
operational_playbook: docs/runbooks/replay_runbook.md contains triage steps and common remediation mappings
Alert: CI flap rate for prompt-regression-jobs should be monitored; reduce noise threshold after 3 successful dry-run replays
If classifier suggests 'tokenization-drift', run tokenization-lint and bump tokenizer mapping; refer to SUP-384 notes
notes_for_release: Non-breaking fix. Adds a new CI artifact type 'prompt-replay-summary.json' which can be consumed by dashboarding tools. Recommend release note: 'Improve CI reproducibility for prompt-set regression checks and add automatic failure hints to speed triage.'
